name: Return exception triage preparation
description: Proposed scenario-preparation record for a distribution company's customer-service handling of customer return requests. It records only the supplied workflow description and proposes a human-governed triage decision; it authorizes neither access nor action in enterprise systems.

businessOwner.role: missing: target-enterprise business/process owner role has not been identified
businessOwner.contact: unverifiable: no target-enterprise owner or contact was supplied

processNode: Evidenced: customer service checks order, delivery, return policy, and item condition after a return request. Missing: owner acceptance of the as-is normal, exception, escalation, waiting, and rework paths.
userRoles: Proposed: supervisor for escalated return exceptions
decisionOrAction: Proposed triage only: advise a human reviewer to route a return request to direct return, request additional information, rejection, or supervisor escalation. Missing: target-enterprise decision policy, decision owner, and route acceptance; no automated or persistent action is authorized.

metrics.name: Return-request triage cycle time
metrics.definition: proposed: elapsed time from receipt of a return request to a human-recorded triage route, with waiting and rework reported separately; formal target-enterprise metric definition is missing.
metrics.cadence: missing: no target-enterprise measurement cadence supplied

metrics.name: Return-request rework rate
metrics.definition: proposed: share of return requests that require a repeated check or additional-information cycle before a human-recorded triage route; formal target-enterprise metric definition is missing.
metrics.cadence: missing: no target-enterprise measurement cadence supplied

ontologyReferences.purpose: Missing: no governed definitions, semantic owner, or version were supplied for return request, order, delivery record, return policy, item condition, route, waiting, or rework.

sourceReferences.purpose: Missing: source systems and permitted use were not supplied. Unverifiable: authority, freshness, and access for order, delivery, policy, and item-condition evidence.

acceptanceCriteria: Missing: target-enterprise owner must accept the as-is process path, including normal, exception, escalation, waiting, and rework paths, before any capability design.
Missing: target-enterprise decision-policy owner must approve the four proposed triage routes and the evidence, conflict, and escalation handling for each route.

Missing: target-enterprise owner must define and accept metrics, baseline, target, cadence, source authority, semantic version, access boundary, and production acceptance criteria before enterprise use.
notes: Evidence ledger: evidenced only from the scenario request are the customer-service workflow checks, the four candidate outcomes, and waiting/rework as reported problems. The triage decision, supervisor role, and metrics are proposed preparation hypotheses. Owner/contact, as-is acceptance, baseline, targets, metric definitions/cadence, semantic owner/version, sources/authority/freshness/access, decision policy, acceptance criteria, and production authority are missing or unverifiable. Restriction: this proposed record permits no source access, recommendation, automation, write-back, release, or production claim.
